episode_event_8080_anniversary/4001_1001:
I wasn’t expecting you to show me
Greninja’s Mega Evolution!

We’ve been strengthening our bond here
on Pasio.
I think that’s what led us to this new power!
Greninja’s helped me a lot up till now.

And now that he can Mega Evolve, I’m sure
I’ll rely on him even more!

He does seem like a dependable partner!
You’re shining brighter than ever!

I have the perfect role for you both
to showcase your brilliance.
Would you like to try it?
That’s what I like to hear!
I’ve reached out to another Trainer as well...
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4002_1001:
Professor Sycamore suggested we hold a
party to celebrate, so that’s precisely what
we’ll do!

Allow me to introduce the sync pairs leading
the festivities!

Today, we’re gonna fill the arena with
Mega Evolution!

First, we’ll show you just how marvelous
Mega Evolution can be!
Then everyone can join in the fun!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/6801_1031:
You ready to rock this
party or what?
episode_event_8080_anniversary/6801_1001:
I’m not exaggerating when I say we’re the
ones who’ll make or break this party.

We’ll have to do our best to meet everyone’s
expectations!

Let’s make our Mega Evolutions shine in
everyone’s memories!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4003_1001: Whoa, impressive!
’Tis an honor to see.
Did you already know about Greninja?
Why, of course!
After all, it’s known as the Ninja Pokémon!

I hadn’t realized Mega Evolution could give
it such power!

I guess it’s your first time seeing it in this
form, then.

When he Mega Evolves, he changes how he
battles. Instead of hiding, he stays out in
the open.

Plus, his reflexes get super sharp. As his
Trainer, it can be difficult to keep up!

That pose oozes confidence, like he knows
he’s gonna win.

Since Greninja has a new look, I took
a page out of his book...
and wore a fancy party look to match!

Not bad! Matching your partner Pokémon is
advanced stuff!
You really know what suits you, huh.
’Tis an inspiration to mine eyes!
Thank you all so much for the kind words!
That said...

How on earth do you battle with such a
strong Pokémon?
No Pokémon is perfect for every situation.

You’ve gotta drag your opponents into a
position where you’ve got the upper hand!

For example, I like to change the weather to
shake things up!
Oooh, that sounds tough to beat!

Perhaps there are Pokémon with ninja
techniques that rival Greninja’s!

Yeah! We may not know any yet, but some
could show up on Pasio one day!
I’d love to meet more ninja-like Pokémon!
You all sure are ninja fans, huh.
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4004_1001:
Red! I’ve got something that’s just as good
as that Terastallization you’ve been using.

I trained hard with Dragonite to harness the
power of Mega Evolution!
So remember this!

No matter how high you climb, I’ll always
catch up!

It’s great to have a rival you can go all out
against, isn’t it?

Yeah! It’s also great to know you’ll always
have that dynamic!
I’m curious, Blue... Why Dragonite?
I don’t think I’ve seen you battle with him.

I wanted to keep him a surprise—as my
secret weapon!

I was waiting for the right moment to let him
strut his stuff!

I did get some battle tactics and tips for
raising him from Lance.
But you already noticed, didn’t ya?

Can’t get anything past you when it comes
to Pokémon!

You may be rivals, but you truly seem to
understand each other!
By the way...

Isn’t this supposed to be a party? Why’re
Red and Leon wearing their usual?
May’s all dressed up!

I’m just wearing this ’cause I had to attend a
Pokémon researchers gathering with my dad.
I’ll have you know I’m not slacking!

This uniform is what I wear when I’m having
a serious battle!
I’m guessing it’s the same for you, Red?

What’s that? You feel most comfortable
battling in clothes you’re used to?
Well, I guess you’ve got your reasons.
Hey, May. When it comes to dress code...
this is OUR win, hands down!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4005_1001:
With you and your Mega-Evolved Beedrill
side by side...
you look fantastic! Just fantastic!

Lookin’ good, kiddo! Gimme all sorts of
poses!
Like...this?

That bug Pokémon! I’ve never seen it in
Kitakami!
Yeah, me neither.

In fact, I’ve also never seen it in Sinnoh,
where I’m from.
Really?
It’s very common in Kanto!

I met this one in Viridian Forest when she
was a Weedle, and I raised her until she
evolved!
She grew quickly. I can truly depend on her.

That’s one thing about bug Pokémon...
They grow fast!

They’re especially reliable when you’re first
starting out as a Trainer!
They grow quickly, huh...

I guess it’s the same for kids around your
age, Leaf, Kieran.

It’s amazing how fast you kiddos grow so
big and strong.
Yeah!

I feel like every time I see you, you shine
even brighter than before!

As you gain experience and grow, your
horizons expand at the speed of light.
Those moments are so beautiful!

You young Trainers and your bug Pokémon
have infinite potential.

I’ll be sure to snap some photos of you
sync pairs—and all the beautiful moments
you can only experience now!

Then...now’s our chance to have a battle!
The kind only had in the present!
Will you battle me and Yanmega?
You bet I will!
Oooh, a bug Pokémon showdown!
How exciting!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4006_1001: When I see you together, it takes me back.

To that incident we handled at the
Lake of Rage?

Team Rocket really crossed a line back then,
didn’t they!

Team Rocket had manipulated radio waves
in Johto...

which forced the Magikarp in the lake to
evolve into Gyarados.
It was. We can’t let that happen again.

Pokémon Evolution should be like what
Ethan’s achieved.

Ethan’s an outstanding Trainer who’s forged
a strong bond with his Pokémon, paving the
way for Mega Evolution.

I once battled a Mega-Evolved Gyarados,
so I can tell...
That Gyarados of yours is super strong!

He’s really powerful, so I’ve got to stay on
my game so he doesn’t rage again!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4007_1001: Wo...WONDERBUL!

You’ve really outdone yourself. He looks
so strong!
Hehe! Thanks!
Mega Evolution, huh?
Hm? Why so apathetic?

Don’t you want to try Mega Evolution too,
Drayton?

Eh, if it happens, it happens. It’s not the sort
of thing that can be forced, you know?

You’ve got a point! Sometimes not forcing it
leads to better results!

Mega Evolution doesn’t just happen because
you, the Trainer, want it to.

If you try to rush it, you might swing
and miss.

Sometimes it’s good to take a stroll on the
scenic path...right?
Heh heh! See? You get it, buddy!
Of course. I didn’t mean to pressure you.

It is indeed important to take things at your
own pace.
That said...

At times, it is equally important to let your
heart lead the way!
So...what exactly do you want me to do?

All I’m saying is that sometimes, you might
do well to tune in to your feelings.

When I see such a ferocious dragon
before me...

it makes me feel a certain way. Surely you
too, Drayton?

Yeah, I guess I DO feel something stir in
my blood.

And we don’t ever get to see Mega-Evolved
dragon Pokémon at Blueberry Academy...
So you’re interested?

Guess so. The more you have up your
sleeve, the more fun battles are!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4008_1001:
I want more opportunities to show how
great Mega Evolution is!

I’ll keep on mastering Mega Evolution and
teach everyone about it. That’s my duty as
the successor!

I’d like to use my work as an actress to
show the whole world the wonder of
Mega Evolution!

That is my role and duty, as someone who
stands in the spotlight both onstage and as
Champion.

It’s a huge responsibility...but awesome if
you enjoy it!

Yes. It’s a joy when what you love and can
do align.

I want to master every Mega Evolution
someday!

Then you might find it interesting to go on a
journey.

You could keep discovering worlds you’ve
yet to see.
A journey, you say? That sounds lovely.

I occasionally visit new places when I’m
filming. It often leads to new encounters.

It could also be fun to adventure wherever
your heart takes you!

Yeah! When I journeyed to find N, finding
him was all I could think about.

But lately, I’ve been considering a journey of
discovery!

I guess in the end, you two were able to
reunite on Pasio, huh?

I bet I could even find new Mega Evolutions
while traveling!

Yeah! If you ever go on a journey like that,
Korrina, you’ve got my full support!
episode_event_8080_anniversary/4009_1001:
Each of your Mega Evolutions left a special,
shining memory in people’s hearts.

Thanks to you all, today will be a day we’ll
never forget!
We were happy to help! I had a great time!

There are actually some Mega Evolutions
that even I only recently learned about!

It’s experiences like that—that surprise and
move you—that make Pokémon research
so fun!

There could be as much potential in Mega
Evolution as there are number of bonds
between Pokémon and Trainers!

To see what Mega Evolution can truly
offer us...
we’ve one last thing we gotta do. Ready?
Yup! I was thinking the same!
Let’s finish off this party with one last battle!

We’ll show you the shine of our unique
Mega Evolutions...
